newsitem.title: KENYA: International aid workers evacuate from Goma-U.N..
newsitem.headline: International aid workers evacuate from Goma-U.N..

text.p: More than 100 international aid workers fled on Saturday from the war-ravaged eastern Zaire town of Goma into Rwanda, a U.N. official said.
Brenda Barton of the U.N. World Food Programme said 117 aid workers had arrived safely in the Rwanda border town of Gisenyi.
Barton said the aid workers had crossed into Rwanda at about 10.45 a.m. (0845 GMT).
The fighting in Goma has pitted Tutsi rebels and Rwandan army troops against Zairean soldiers and militiamen, correspondents in the city said.
The evacuation from Goma leaves 1.1 million Rwandan refugees in Zaire with little or no support from international aid workers.
"In terms of personnel, if there were any left it would be a very limited number," said Barton.
